scope: Phase A operator acceptance in disposable local Supabase/Auth/PostgreSQL. Not a hosted staff rollout or live financial/registrar acceptance.
newlyPassedBrowserJourneys: Non-owner Operations Administrator creates an invitation-based customer through the normal secured form
Synthetic incomplete provisioning reservation resumed through the staff UI, followed by retry of the same request after an injected lost successful response
Owner changes the same active staff identity to Domain Manager through Team & Permissions
Domain Manager verifies and assigns a separate recovery domain fixture, then retries the same durable request after an injected lost response
Domain Manager denied Billing, Support, Services and Team workspaces
Owner restores Operations Administrator role without resetting credentials or MFA
Operator recovers synthetic confirmed-unsent, pre-dispatch notification using existing guarded backend operation
Changed inline confirmation supports Cancel recovery and Confirm queue once, without a native browser prompt
Owner suspends an already-active staff session, next staff request is denied
After the relevant UI fix, suspension automatically clears the active workspace on the next rejected request without a manual reload
fixtureLimitations: One staff identity transitioned between Operations Administrator and Domain Manager, not two independently hired employees
Owner authentication is disposable fixture setup. Staff password and authenticator were entered personally by the founder
Incomplete provisioning and unsent-email failures are explicitly seeded local fixtures, not claims of natural provider outages
Response-loss tests replace a successful response after the real local backend commits
Spaceship, Brevo and Turnstile transports are fixtures. Prior genuine provider acceptance is not repeated
The initial native-HTML fault-control form didn't seed its intended state. It was corrected to fetch-based submission and verified before counting recovery passes
productFixes: Completed provisioning says Client created rather than Retry same request
Notification recovery confirmation is in-page, bound to the selected notification, and retains backend safeguards
Authorization rejection invalidates the requesting workspace and signals other tabs without identity/token storage
Operations includes bounded service-invoice payment records separately from domain orders
Sandbox service-payment provider check validates account, checkout, invoice, client, amount, currency and environment without changing financial state
sandboxProviderReadback: New provider-check control requires separate hosted verification after deployment. It doesn't create a transaction or claim domain-renewal acceptance.
knownLimits: Live customer charges, registrar renewal execution, production schedules and customer-domain assignment remain separately gated
An uncertain checkout without a provider payment reference, refund/dispute outcome, or legal registrar action remains owner-reviewed. The new check doesn't repair these states
Support and service history still have documented bounded windows rather than unlimited historical pagination
